newsitem.title: USA: Oakhurst to sell Steel City Products plant.
newsitem.headline: Oakhurst to sell Steel City Products plant.

text.p: Oakhurst Co said Monday it agreed to sell its Steel City Products plant in Pittsburgh for $2.85 million and to move the car accessories ditributor's operations to a leased facility in the Pittsburgh area at the end of 1997.

The company said it intends to use the sale's net proceeds -- after repaying a $1.1 million term loan and selling expenses -- to reduce working capital credit lines and cover moving expenses. Oakhurst added it expected to close the sale in December. A company spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate.
